project.label: Playable worlds, product-value pressure, and pre-G0 game direction research
project.thesis: Keep registered product truth separate from Game research, use the cheapest claim-preserving pressure before escalating evidence cost, and let actual product consequences—not Agent sophistication or one observer—decide what deserves promotion.
project.question: Which game form deserves further investment, which Agent roles materially improve it, and which remaining product claims require machine, player, or market evidence?
owns: Registered Station Zero product and executable Game truth
Game Core research treatments and player-facing experiments
R1–R29 Game Foundations research corpus and reopen conditions
Pre-G0 direction search and playable-proof evidence
boundary: Station Zero v2 is the only registered current product
Station Zero v3, Casefile, Last Light, and Echo Hunt are research/reference treatments rather than selected product stages
No next Ordivon Game product has been selected from the recent direction experiments
Foundation expansion is provisionally frozen after R29 and reopens only on a concrete counterexample
No generic Host, Runtime, or universal Game-engine authority
project.problem: A technically impressive Agent mechanic, a large simulation battery, or one Human reaction can each look persuasive without establishing a game worth continuing. Game must keep product registration, machine Product Value, human-specific Player Value, and broader population/market consequence as separate evidence targets.
project.capability: Runs the registered Station Zero v2 product while retaining v3 and other treatments as executable research pressure. Station Zero v3 now has owner-native Product Value lanes with cheap objective/profile slices, currentness-fenced retained evidence, browser/playable proof, and a full promotion matrix; recent natural dogfood used those pressures to reject two plausible fixes and correct a real Core extraction defect without making Human approval a default inner-loop gate.
project.maturity: Registered playable v2 product plus active pre-G0 product-value/direction research; no next product selected
project.audience: Players, game designers, and Agent researchers examining how game form, delegation, partial knowledge, autonomous production pressure, and later human/market evidence become—or fail to become—Player Value.
project.latestProof: On 2026-08-24 natural Product Value dogfood traced a Core cargo successor defect, rejected unrelated Heat/scan fixes, and promoted one objective-scoped correction after exact regression, 18-profile negative controls, evidence revalidation, and 350/350 repository checks. The current matrix keeps Rescue at 3/6 focus-complete victories and Hive at 6/6 while Core rises from 1/6 to 5/6; v2 remains the only registered product.
project.summary: Ordivon Game separates the registered product from executable research treatments and now has a real autonomous product-pressure loop: cheap scoped falsifiers can change canonical behavior, broader retained standing is revalidated before promotion, and Human evidence is reserved for claims that are actually human-specific rather than used as a universal approval stage.
project.state: Station Zero v2 remains the only registered current product. Station Zero v3 remains an unregistered reference/product target, but its current Product Value evidence is materially stronger than the earlier playable-proof snapshot: owner-native machine pressure can now falsify and improve product behavior, with Core completion at 5/6 deterministic profiles after the latest correction. No next product or G0 direction has been selected. Human evidence remains necessary for unresolved human-specific experience claims, not as the default next gate for every Game change.
